name: Square: find a customer
description: Look up a Square customer by email address or phone number. Body: { "query": "jane@example.com" } or { "query": "803-555-0142" }. Returns up to 5 matches with name, email and phone.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ limit: 5, query: { filter: String($json.body.query ?? '').includes('@') ? { email_address: { fuzzy: String($json.body.query) } } : { phone_number: { fuzzy: String($json.body.query ?? '') } } } }) }}
